messages.subject: shift labels (scale_x_continuous)
parts:
Hello,

I created a plot (syntax and data below) that needs improvement in following points:
1) I want the labels to be shifted slightly to the left. The labels should stand for the interval not for the "breaks".
2) I want no colour legend. How do I make it to disappear?

Thanks Hermann

 
ggplot (df) + geom_point (aes(x=pos, y=value, colour = factor (bin)))+ scale_x_continuous (breaks = pos, labels =c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five"))

dput (df)
structure(list(pos = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), value = c(2, 4, 7, 1,
6), bin = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 0)), .Names = c("pos", "value", "bin"
), row.names = c(NA, -5L), class = "data.frame")
> df
  pos value bin
1   1     2   1
2   2     4   1
3   3     7   0
4   4     1   1
5   5     6   0

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: shift labels (scale_x_continuous)
parts:
Hi:

Here's an extreme example of hjust since I'm not really sure what you
mean by 'shifted slightly'. Adjust to your needs. You may have some
issues since your axis tick labels don't have the same width.

df <- structure(list(pos = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), value = c(2, 4, 7, 1,

6), bin = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 0)), .Names = c("pos", "value", "bin"
), row.names = c(NA, -5L), class = "data.frame")

scale_x_continuous (breaks = df$pos,
labels =c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five"),
limits = c(0, 5)) +
scale_colour_discrete(guide = "none") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 3))

Dennis
